result.title: Neural Collapse on Imbalanced Datasets and Open-Set Scenario
result.summary: Neural collapse (NC) describes the elegant geometric structure that sample features and classifier vectors exhibit when a classification model's loss reaches its minimum. Class imbalance, however, generally distorts standard NC. In this paper, we theoretically reformulate NC on imbalanced datasets and in open-set settings. Our analysis is based on an optimization problem over class-wise averaged losses, rather than the global averaged losses used in prior NC studies. We prove that when class-wise averaged losses attain their minima, standard NC is achieved on balanced or imbalanced datasets, for both cross-entropy (CE) and binary cross-entropy (BCE) losses. We further extend the analysis to an open-set-inspired scenario, where some classes contain no training samples yet are still assigned classifier vectors in the losses. We find that in this scenario, when class-wise averaged losses reach their minima, standard NC still emerges on the known classes with training samples, while the classifier vectors of unknown classes without training samples overlap with each other and become orthogonal to those of the known classes. Finally, we analyze Softmax- and Sigmoid-based contrastive losses re-balanced by inverse sample frequency, proving that at their minima on balanced or imbalanced datasets, sample features of different classes likewise form standard NC.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在类别不平衡与开集设定下重新推导 Neural Collapse（NC），将分析对象从全局平均损失改为类别平均损失，证明 CE 与 BCE 达到最小时仍出现标准 NC；开集情形下未知类别的分类向量互相重合且与已知类正交；并分析按逆样本频率重平衡的对比损失。
AI.relevance_reason: NC 是对特征与分类向量几何结构的精确刻画，可能为核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否按任务要素（如视觉细节、实体、证据类别）形成稳定几何、以及不均衡监督下表示是否坍缩提供分析视角，但原文不涉及多模态推理，迁移性需自行判断。
